assumptions.assumption: The fixed Display policy root must be captured as present or genuinely absent, with other acquisition errors retained.
assumptions.basis: Both owning callers stop at the exact root;576native observations include attributes0x240 and all return C0000034.
assumptions.dependent-result: Bounded immutable selection of this root, not permanent absence.
assumptions.stress-test: Present controlled/synthetic trees, scope boundaries, view/grant replay, duplicate/budget rejection.
assumptions.falsification-probe: A successful native root open must be captured; denial or enumeration failures cannot become absence.
